title: Capacitor charge polarity
description: Essential: Correctly identifies plate M as positively charged using the right-hand rule on the rotating rod system.

title: Final capacitor charge
description: Essential: Calculates the fully charged capacitor charge Q = 0.54 C using the induced EMF and capacitance.

title: EMF from rotating rods
description: Important: Applies Faraday's law to find the induced EMF in the rotating rod system as (1/2)*B1*ω*r².

title: Discharged charge calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates ΔQ = 0.16 C by linking capacitor discharge to rod ejection via impulse-momentum theorem and energy conservation.

title: Post-collision motion analysis
description: Important: Applies conservation of momentum for the inelastic collision and conservation of energy for the rise on the incline.

title: Frame deceleration in field
description: Important: Uses the impulse-momentum theorem with magnetic force to find the deceleration distance Δx of the frame in the magnetic field.

title: Maximum distance x
description: Essential: Correctly computes the final maximum distance x = 0.14 m by adding the deceleration distance to the initial uniform motion distance.

title: Sign error in EMF polarity
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the positive plate (N instead of M) due to misapplying the right-hand rule or Faraday's law sign convention.

title: Omitting collision inelasticity
description: Pitfall: Treats the rod-frame collision as elastic or fails to use conservation of momentum with combined mass.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Fails to use consistent SI units (e.g., meters, seconds, teslas) leading to incorrect numerical answers.
